claim: Team delivery validation was extracted into a dedicated module without changing its validation sequence. Complete CAS text reads, hash verification, and UTF-8 conversion used by DeliveryGate and review now run on Tokio's blocking pool; the same verified complete text is passed to existing validators.
limits: No Cargo compilation, Rust tests, clippy, runtime tasks, or model calls were run.
The organizational extraction and blocking-pool I/O change do not establish improvements in end-to-end latency, tool calls, token usage, or delivery quality.
An individual artifact still requires full-body allocation for current validators; the cache's 32 MiB limit applies to retained reuse, not to the largest single-body allocation.
Blocking-pool execution prevents synchronous CAS reads from occupying Tokio worker threads but does not reduce the bytes read or hash work.
verification: rustfmt --check --edition 2021 --config skip_children=true passed for the five affected Rust files.
git diff --check passed for tracked modified Rust files; Python whitespace and source-hash scan covered changed Rust, documentation, and evidence.
